name: Shop Showcase
summary: An editorial shop page with no cart: a big serif-friendly headline beside a collage of three overlapping product photos on an arch with a turning name badge, filter chips over an image-first grid of 8 products (one featured, one wide) where every card has an 'Ask about this' button that opens a text or email already naming the product, a dark 'how to order' band, a story block with visit details, and a shipping/returns FAQ.
best_for: seller who takes orders by text or DM

sections.name: topbar
sections.what: Thin dark strip: 'Call or text {{phone}}' (and the hours on bigger screens)
sections.edit: Keep it short; delete the section if the shop takes no calls

sections.name: header
sections.what: Sticky header: initial in a circle + shop name, 4 anchor links (desktop), 'How to order' button
sections.edit: Match the links to the sections that remain

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Kicker ({{city}}), h1 with an <em> word under a hand-drawn accent squiggle, lead, two buttons, address + hours; collage of photos hero-1 (tall), hero-2 (landscape), hero-3 (square) with a 'N°01' caption and a turning badge that spells the shop name and city
sections.edit: Rewrite the h1 (2 to 5 words, keep one <em> word) and the lead with what the shop sells. Use the three best product or shop photos. The badge text reads '{{business}} · {{city}} · shop small ·': edit the words inside <textPath> if you like, keep it under about 40 characters

sections.name: shop
sections.what: Heading, filter chips (All / New / Gifts / Everyday / Seasonal, counts filled in by app.js), status line, and 8 product cards: photo, optional tag, name, one line, price (default 'Price on request'), 'Ask about this' button. Card 1 is featured (big), card 6 is wide
sections.edit: One card per real product with its real name, one honest line and the real price text; never invent prices, keep 'Price on request' when unknown. Set each card's data-cat to the chip categories it belongs to (space separated) and rename/delete chips to match; a chip with no products hides itself. Delete extra cards from the end. The grid's data-ask-via can be auto (text on phones, email on computers), sms or email

sections.name: order
sections.what: Dark full-width band: three numbered steps (pick, call or text, pick up or delivery) and Call / Send a text / Email buttons
sections.edit: Rewrite the steps to match how the owner really takes orders (pickup only, delivery, deposit, lead time). Delete buttons for channels the owner does not use

sections.name: story
sections.what: Tall photo (slot about) with a round accent stamp (initial + city), heading, pull paragraph, second paragraph, Visit / Hours / Call or text list
sections.edit: Write the owner's story in their own words; if there is no story, delete the two paragraphs and keep the visit list

sections.name: faq
sections.what: Heading, 5 shipping/pickup/payment/returns/custom-order questions as native <details> (first open), and a 'Still not sure?' contact card
sections.edit: Every answer is a generic instruction: replace each with the owner's real policy or delete that question. Never promise shipping, returns or custom work the owner did not confirm

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Huge shop-name wordmark, Visit / Contact / Shop columns, copyright, back to top
sections.edit: Keep the contact tokens; match links to remaining sections

photo_slots.hint: the hero product or the shop's best photo; shown tall (4:5), centre of interest in the middle
a second product, a display or the shop front (4:3)
a close-up detail: texture, packaging, a hand at work (1:1)
featured product, the one people know you for (shown 4:3 on phones, tall on computers)
product photo on a plain or simple background (4:5)
product photo (4:5); a gift-like item suits the 'Gift' tag
product photo (4:5); a seasonal item suits the 'Seasonal' tag
custom or made-to-order work (shown wide on phones, tall beside its text on computers)
the owner or maker at work, or the inside of the shop (4:5)

behaviors: filter chips with a smooth FLIP layout animation (all products show without JavaScript; chips appear only with it)
chip counts and an aria-live 'Showing n of 8' line
'Ask about this' opens sms: on phones or mailto: on computers, prefilled with the product name
'Send a text' built from the phone number
turning name badge (paused off screen and for reduced motion)
hand-drawn squiggle under the h1 word
two collage photos drift on scroll (data-parallax)
sticky header and reveal on scroll from motion.js
style_notes: Works with every style: photos get a frame in the page colour so they separate even when the style has no shadow; hard-shadow styles (neo-brutalist, poster-bold, retro-americana) give the collage a printed look. Strongest with editorial-serif, soft-pastel, warm-hospitality, earthy-craft and dark-luxury. Tested at 390 and 1280 px with editorial-serif, midnight-neon, neo-brutalist, soft-pastel, poster-bold and dark-luxury. The 'how to order' band uses the ink colour as its background, so it is dark on light styles and light on dark styles.
